name: anki-week
description: Build a week's AnKing Step Deck study set from lecture materials — map each lecture's objectives to AnKing cards, unsuspend + tag them, build a filtered deck per lecture, coverage-audit every objective, then hand off to study-week. Also builds interactive, source-grounded NBME/USMLE-style practice exams from those same materials, with a validated faculty blueprint and a remediation report. Deck building requires Anki desktop open with the Anki MCP Server add-on (code 124672614); the exam builder does not.
